title: VCs Catch Liars
primary_theme: Unconditional founder support through customers, recruiting, and fundraising help
founder_lessons: Choose investors who assume they do not know better than the founder but will become the strongest possible support system.
Ask for specific help on first customers, recruiting, and fundraising where the investor network can materially change outcomes.
Treat finalist candidate references as real diligence, not a perfunctory step.
Remember that value add is a mindset of proactive observation and help, not meetings that waste founder time.
notable_quotes: I try to just be a very unconditional support system for the founders.
The first customers are going to, uh, help you get to product market fit or not.
I think that future fundraising, you know, I typically quarter, you know, it depends on the founders.
